popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Hellen's son Dorus receives the land opposite the Peloponnese and names his people Dorians — the eponym who gives Greek ethnography its Dorian stem.

popCulture.title: Dorus
popCulture.description: Son of Hellen and Orseis; brother of Xuthus and Aeolus — legendary progenitor of the Dorians.

popCulture.title: Dorians
popCulture.description: The historical Greek ethnos still carries Dorus' name — dialect, invasion legends, and the Dorian identity of Sparta and Crete.
